 Inde Navarrette Stars in David Yurman’s 2026 Holiday Campaign
 Alongside Michael B. Jordan and Yerin Ha, the stars of the moment celebrates the magic of New York with the jewelry titan leading the festivities 
 Inde Navarrette Stars in David Yurman’s 2026 Holiday Campaign
 Alongside Michael B. Jordan and Yerin Ha, the stars of the moment celebrates the magic of New York with the jewelry titan leading the festivities 
 November 5, 2026 
 Text by Joda Amankrah
 With spooky season behind us, all eyes are turning to the holidays, and who better to usher in the festivities than David Yurman? The brand’s 2026 holiday campaign, starring Global Brand Ambassador Michael B. Jordan alongside Inde Navarrette and Yerin Ha, brings a little seasonal magic to the streets of New York. 
 Courtesy of David Yurman 
 Set against the familiar charm of Washington Square Park, the campaign captures the joy of togetherness and the unmistakable enchantment of the holidays in the city. Across a series of quintessential New York moments, Jordan and Ha go head-to-head in a festive card game, while Navarrette takes to the streets in search of the perfect holiday gift, hailing a cab along the way.
 Courtesy of David Yurman 
 Naturally, no New York holiday moment would be complete without a little sparkle. Adorned in David Yurman designs, from 18K gold Cable bracelets to pieces from the Starburst and Armory collections, Jordan, Ha and Navarrette bring the brand’s signature craftsmanship to the season’s celebrations.
 Courtesy of David Yurman 
 With the city as their backdrop and David Yurman as their finishing touch, David Yurman’s holiday collection serves as a reminder to pull down those cobwebs, put the pumpkins away and turn your attention to the holidays. And with our eyes on Jordan, Ha and Navarrette, how could you not?
